paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.16 as of 2026-10-16, representing a 6.92 percent decrease from the prior close and a 36.16 percent decrease over 22 sessions. There have been 9 new news headlines in the last 24 hours. Recent news includes an amendment to the terms of an equipment supply loan financing from MUFG Bank and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission issuing a draft environmental impact statement for Fermi America's Matador units.

Recent news headlines also include Cantor Fitzgerald reducing their target price on shares of Fermi from $12.00 to $8.00 and setting an "overweight" rating on the stock. Additionally, the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a preliminary recommendation supporting a combined licence for four planned Westinghouse AP1000 reactor units at Fermi America's Project Matador.
